meaning.zh:
“千钧一发时刻得救” 或 “险险脱身”。

这个短语源自拳击比赛，当一个拳击手被对手逼得几乎无法支撑时，恰好响起了回合结束的铃声，使得拳击手得以暂时逃脱困境。在现代英语中，这个短语广泛用于各种情况下，指在危急时刻因某种外部因素而得救。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from boxing matches. When a boxer is on the verge of being knocked out by the opponent, the end-of-round bell rings, allowing the boxer to temporarily escape the dire situation. In contemporary English, the phrase is widely used in various contexts to denote being saved from a critical situation by some external factor.

lines.en: I was about to be called to present my project, but I was *saved by the bell* when the fire alarm went off.
lines.zh: 我马上要被叫去展示我的项目时，火警铃响了，让我险险脱身。

lines.en: Just before the teacher could collect our homework, the bell rang—we were *saved by the bell*!
lines.zh: 就在老师要收作业前，铃声响了——我们险险脱身。

lines.en: He was struggling to answer the tough question, but luckily, the meeting was adjourned. He was *saved by the bell*.
lines.zh: 他努力回答那个难题，但幸运的是，会议结束了。他险险脱身。
